shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git status --short && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -50

cat index.html src/App.tsx src/index.css src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

git diff package.json; npm audit 2>&1 | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles

grep -n "ThemeProvider\|Flex\b\|Card\b\|TextInput\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; grep -n "ThemeProvider" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "rootClassName\|scoped\|theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -20
